title: 现有系统泛化任务遗漏了什么？以推理为中心的分析
summary: 论文指出当前系统泛化任务通过线性动作组合、基于生产力的测试和动作显式目标等简化，遗漏了归纳与溯因推理的关键要素。作者提出TranSGrid测试平台，统一演绎、归纳与溯因推理，实验显示七个Transformer模型在TranSGrid上表现远差于普通测试集，最大模型仅解决55.3%，最难子集仅15.8%。
summary_en: The paper argues that existing systematic generalization tasks rely on simplifications—approximately linear action composition, productivity-based tests, and action-explicit goals—that omit key inductive and abductive reasoning demands. The authors introduce TranSGrid, a testbed unifying deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning. Experiments with seven Transformers on 4,800 instances show all models perform far worse than on held-out test sets: the largest solves 79.6% of the test set but only 55.3% of TranSGrid and 15.8% of the hardest subset.
